results.title: Arbitrary code execution via full_load
results.content: PyYAML before 5.4 is vulnerable: yaml.full_load and FullLoader can construct arbitrary Python objects from untrusted input.

results.title: NVD CVE-2020-14343
results.content: A vulnerability was discovered in the PyYAML library in versions before 5.4, where it is susceptible to arbitrary code execution when it processes untrusted YAML files through the full_load method or with the FullLoader loader.
